description: Bounded parameters for deterministic page feature extraction (babeldoc/magazine/page_features.py). Numeric parameters carry a '<name>_allowed_range' sibling of the form 'low..high', inclusive on both ends. List parameters are closed vocabularies (IL structure values such as upstream form types and layout labels, or feature names); the list is its own bound, so it takes no allowed range. 'percentile_features' selects which raw features get a document level '<name>_pctl' companion from extract_document_features; every name must be a declared feature. Tuning happens here; the extractor holds no literals of either kind.
